entities.name: Sabra
entities.description: A new sell-sword and expedition mercenary from Zendikar who survived a throat-slitting by Anowon.

entities.name: Anowon
entities.description: A figure who ambushed Sabra after she recovered the chest and slit her throat.

entities.name: Murasa Expedition House
entities.description: The expedition house from which Sabra's first expedition set out.

entities.name: Beyond Man
entities.description: A mysterious figure who hired the expedition to find a chest with a draconic symbol.

entities.name: Carnage Altar
entities.description: A site with a tomb beneath it where the dragon relic chest was found.

entities.name: Dragon relic chest
entities.description: A chest bearing a draconic symbol that likely held information about the Eye of Ugin.

entities.name: Eye of Ugin
entities.description: A mysterious cave believed to be hidden in the mountains of Akoum.

events.summary: Sabra joins her first expedition out of the Murasa Expedition House, hired by a Beyond Man to find a chest.
events.quote: Sabra was a new sell-sword and joined her first expedition out of the Murasa Expedition House

events.summary: The party finds the dragon relic chest beneath Carnage Altar but a terrifying creature kills most of them; Sabra delivers the killing blow.
events.quote: Sabra managed to deliver the killing blow to the monster

events.summary: Anowon ambushes Sabra and slits her throat; she glimpses her attacker before losing consciousness.
events.quote: Sabra was ambushed by Anowon, who emerged from the shadows and slit her throat

events.summary: Sabra survives and returns to tell her employer what happened.
events.quote: Sabra survived the expedition and returned to tell her employer of what had happened

relations.note: Attacked her and left her near-fatally wounded.
Her party was hired by him.
relations.quote: The party was hired by a mysterious figure
